verdict.rationale: Xero has JAX, an AI feature that categorizes and matches bank transactions during reconciliation, plus an MCP server and API/SDK access that could let an agent orchestrate reconciliation tasks. However, there is no evidence of an agent performing a full month-end close workflow (matching, exception flagging, and preparing a close packet for human review) end-to-end. missing for 10: evidence of exception flagging logic, month-end close preparation/summary output, and an end-to-end autonomous agent workflow beyond transaction categorization.
